name: io.github.tonyyang0504/lazada_open_platform-mcp
description: Lazada Seller Center + Lazada Open Platform (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_product, g

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_LAZADA_OPEN_PLATFORM_APP_KEY
environmentVariables.description: App Key of your Lazada Open Platform app (App Console).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_LAZADA_OPEN_PLATFORM_APP_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: App Secret of the same app; signs every call: uppercase hex HMAC-SHA256 over the API name (e.g. /order/get) + the parameters sorted by name as name+value. Never sent on the wire.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_LAZADA_OPEN_PLATFORM_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Seller access_token from the seller-authorisation code exchange (/auth/token/create). It expires (see expires_in); renew it with the signed system API /auth/token/refresh and update this value — the runtime does not refresh it.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_LAZADA_OPEN_PLATFORM_DOMAIN
environmentVariables.description: Country gateway of the seller's shop: sg, com.my, co.th, co.id, com.ph or vn → https://api.lazada.{domain}/rest (Service Endpoints on every API page).
